RPSC Sub Inspector 2021 Re Exam Admit Card - Complete Details

RPSC Sub Inspector 2021 Re Exam Admit Card. Candidates can now download their admit card / hall ticket from the official website before the exam date. The last date to apply is 09/02/2021. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Apply Online Start Date : 09/02/2021
  • Apply Online Last Date : 23/06/2021
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/06/2021
  • Admit Card Released Date : 17/09/2026
  • Re-Exam Date : 20/09/2026
  • Result Declare Date : As Per Schedule
  • Download Re-Exam Admit Card : Server 1 | Server 2
  • Download Re-Exam Date : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Apply Online Start Date : 09/02/2021
  • Apply Online Last Date : 23/06/2021
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 23/06/2021
  • General / OBC : Rs. 350/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 250/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
